Config Audit Resource Get IP Visibility
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/configAudit/ipVisibility

Retrieves the IP visibility audit report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)

int32

Total GRE locations

string[]

Locations with NAT

GRE tunnels audit recommendation
